unverifiable_exemptions: Real estate licensees (New Jersey Real Estate Commission) are not covered unless the licensee is the landlord of the property
coverage.summary: Applies to residential rental property leased or subleased for dwelling purposes, except dwelling units in one-family or two-family dwellings. Buildings with 3 or more units are covered.

result.notes: min_units 3 comes from the exemption for units in one-family and two-family dwellings. The real estate licensee exemption is about who charges the fee, not about the building, and an address lookup cannot check it. I moved it from other_conditions to unverifiable_exemptions. requires_unknown_facts is set to false because the rule covers ordinary rental buildings. The statute has no owner-occupancy, construction-date or preemption provisions, so those fields stay null.
